Character persistence and runtime stability update. Use Sundial app 0.1.71 or later with this release.

### Fixed
- Keep the game's character and inventory ownership intact when loading and saving.
- Update the bundled mod loader to fix a crash caused by expired Lua strings.
- Include the complete runtime configuration required for initialization.

An older save with damaged character links needs a separate repair from a preserved copy. Updating the software does not automatically recover incorrectly linked or missing items.
